verdict.rationale: The annual-return page states the access prerequisite up front: you must already be a full access manager or filing collaborator, or else hold a corporation key. That is a published credential wall stated before filing begins. For incorporation itself, the pages describe only a five-step process and an Online Filing Centre, with no stated account-creation, login-credential or identity-proofing requirements. Missing for 10: pre-flow disclosure of the account and login requirements for incorporation, any statement of identity-proofing steps, an end-to-end list of every credential gate, and independent or hands-on confirmation that nothing surfaces mid-flow.
